findings.defect: Dense near grass banks read as opaque hedges
findings.evidence: Large solid-looking strips occupy the left/right foreground rather than airy varied silhouettes; the outcrop disappears into this mass.
findings.cause: Hypothesis: many overlapping wide opaque fibres at short distance exceed what this representation can depict attractively. Instance count is unchanged, but projected overlap increases strongly.
findings.action: Reject R3 and restore R2 source/parameters. Do not increase density further or promote the framing-bank technique.

lesson: A stronger foreground requires convincing overlap/silhouette construction, not simply concentrating the existing wide strips near the camera.
remaining: R2 has better landscape/continuity and a cropped asymmetric stone anchor, but foreground grass still has a planar strip character. Preserve that limitation for human review.
